attempts.summary: Fixed the corrupted /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance script (it contained a botched heredoc with literal setup commands baked in as text and was not executable), installed a root crontab entry to run it daily at 02:15 appending to /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log, verified crond is active/enabled, and confirmed via a controlled reboot of node1 that the cron job, script, and log persist and function after restart.
